title: Recovery by e-mail
summary: Asks for the recovery e-mail and sends the link. The person opens the link on this phone; the app then asks for the PIN (recovery-pin with factor emailLink).

phase.description: sending: POST /v1/recovery/email runs. sent: the server answered 202.

emailInvalid.description: true after submit when the address is not plausible.

send.effect: Checks the address locally, then sends POST /v1/recovery/email. On 202 sets phase to sent.

url.description: The recovery link from the e-mail, opened on this phone.

openLink.effect: Takes the token from the link and opens recovery-pin with factor emailLink. A link that holds no token does nothing.

notes: The server answers 202 also for an unknown address, so the screen never says whether an address has an account. bipe_recovery_email_sent says so in its words.
The link lives recoveryLinkMinutes (registries/accounts.json). An old link fails on confirm with recovery_invalid (recovery-pin).

The link opens the app through the universal link or app link of the recovery path. Bipe logic: BipeRecoveryLink.token (iOS and Android); BipeAPIClient.requestRecoveryEmail (iOS), BipeDeviceAccount.requestEmailRecovery (Android).
